cartridges.title: ST010 program dump, 53248 bytes
cartridges.source: external/cartridges/, copied from the cartridge library's 5 Tools & Service Test Carts/CPU/ folder, the file with this digest
cartridges.layout: 16384 program words of three bytes, then 2048 table words of two, each word stored low byte first. Reversing the bytes of every word gives the image named by canonicalSha256, which is what snesst/artifacts.manifest.json pins and what the part runs
cartridges.exercises: The ST010's own microcode run on this member: the handshake, the place the program waits for a command, and command 1 on the point the README uses, answered through the shared memory

cartridges.title: ST018 program and data dump, 163840 bytes
cartridges.source: external/cartridges/, copied from the cartridge library's 5 Tools & Service Test Carts/CPU/ folder, the file with this digest
cartridges.layout: 131072 bytes of ARM program then 32768 of data, in the order the manifest pins, so the file on disk is the image the part runs
cartridges.exercises: The ST018's own program run on this member's ARM part: reset, then a command byte the firmware's table does not hold sent through the mailbox, and the byte its unknown-command path answers with
